propositions: The .reconciler-* gitattributes merge=ours strip arm in init.py is permanently unreachable because the reconciler moved to refs/reconciler/* and the store already ran the migration (last commit 826d5ae379).
The _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES constant and the strip arm (init.py:600-616) must be removed as approved early removal (pre-1.0 pass #3).
The gitattributes ensure-unit's create arm must still write the .bridge_state/* merge=ours carve-out and report converged for existing .gitattributes files.
The drift matrix test coverage must retarget gitattributes drift from 'committed file carries retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes' to match the surviving create-only arm.
All references to _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES must be eliminated from src/ and tests/ (verified by grep).
Release notes must document this as operator-approved early removal (pre-1.0 pass #3, 2026-08-12) following prior deprecation-removal pass format.
